Stanford Employment Agency
Stanford Employment Agency seeks a receptionist for a busy
office. Primary duties include greeting potential clients, filing,
and typing. The successful candidate must have a friendly
manner and be able to operate a multiline telephone system in
a busy office setting. In addition, the receptionist will assist the
office manager as directed.
Candidates must have finished secondary school. Prior
experience in a similar job is helpful but not necessary.
Excellent salary and benefits are offered. Please send a letter
of interest and résumé to Gita Aggarwal, Stanford Employment
Agency, 17 Market Way, Edinburgh, EH1 1TH.
Visit our Web site for more information.
www.stanfordemployment.co.uk
Reo

斯坦福就业机构
斯坦福就业机构为一家繁忙的办公室招聘接待员。主要职责包括迎接潜在客户、归档和打字。成功候选人必须举止友善，并且能够在繁忙的办公室环境中操作多线路电话系统。此外，接待员将根据指示协助办公室经理。
候选人必须已完成中学教育。在类似工作方面的经验有帮助但不是必需的。
提供优厚的薪水和福利。请将意向信和简历发送至 Gita Aggarwal，Stanford Employment Agency, 17 Market Way, Edinburgh, EH1 1TH。
请访问我们的网站了解更多信息。
www.stanfordemployment.co.uk
Reo
